headline: Common Mistakes People Make After Fire Damage
articleBody: When your property has been hit by fire or smoke, it's a stressful time, and it's easy to make missteps that can complicate the recovery. Here are some common mistakes to watch out for. First, delaying calling your insurance or a restoration company. Time is really of the essence with fire damage; corrosive ash and soot can continue to cause damage if not addressed quickly. Second, trying to clean everything yourself with household cleaners. Smoke and soot require specialized cleaning agents and techniques, and improper cleaning can actually spread the damage or set stains. Third, not documenting everything. Taking photos and keeping records of damaged items is vital for your insurance claim. Fourth, not getting multiple estimates. It’s smart to compare services and ensure you’re making an informed decision before remediation work begins. Lastly, underestimating the extent of hidden damage. What looks minor on the surface can mask significant structural or smoke contamination issues. Avoiding these pitfalls can really streamline your recovery. If you're in the San Fernando Valley and feeling overwhelmed, connecting with an experienced restoration company like First To Respond Restoration can make all the difference in getting your property back to normal safely and efficiently.
